Halloween night. The grandma sits alone on the stone step of her dark gate with the basket of roasted chestnuts on her lap, looking down the alley with a lonely little smile. Down the alley the neighbors' gates glow with orange carved pumpkin lanterns with cute smiling faces, but her gate has no lantern.
